toegepas.voor: Werkers skep steenkool in die vuur en die water kook
toegepas.na: Werkers skep steenkool in die vuur, en die water kook
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Werkers skep' and 'die water kook' are two full clauses, so the AWS comma is required and nothing else changes.

toegepas.voor: Die waens dra mense en die trokke
toegepas.na: Die waens dra mense, en die trokke
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die waens dra mense' and 'die trokke dra vrag' are two full clauses, so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: dra die gewig en die wiel sak nie weg nie
toegepas.na: dra die gewig, en die wiele sak nie weg nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma between two full clauses, and plural 'wiele' to match the previous sentence's 'n Trein se wiele'.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses, and a jump to singular 'die wiel' after two sentences about 'wiele'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required, and the plural matches 'n Wa se wiele' and 'n Trein se wiele' in the same paragraph without changing the claim.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The sentence means the oxen could not move the load, so the modal 'kon' is needed.
toegepas.fout: 'nie sou roer nie' reads as unwillingness or a bare hypothetical where inability is meant.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'kon' states that oxen could not move the load, which is what the sentence means, and keeps the comparison unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A railway line 'is geopen'; 'het oopgemaak' follows the English 'the line opened'.
toegepas.fout: 'Daardie lyn het oopgemaak' copies English 'the line opened' for an inauguration.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'is in 1830 geopen' is the standard Afrikaans for a railway line opening, with the same date and the same fact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The two sentences before have 'lyn' and 'Mense' as subjects, so 'hy' is a distant reference; naming him is clearer.
toegepas.fout: 'hy' is a distant reference after two sentences whose subjects are 'lyn' and 'Mense'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming Stephenson, already named in the block, removes the stumble without adding a name or fact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: In a past-tense narrative 'toe' is more natural than 'nou' for 'from then on'.
toegepas.fout: 'Nou' in a past-tense paragraph can be read by a Grade 4 learner as the present day.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Toe' is the natural Afrikaans marker for the moment the change happened and keeps the same time and contrast.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: no comma before 'en' when what follows has no subject and verb of its own.
toegepas.fout: Comma before 'en' where what follows has no subject and verb of its own.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'en nie 'n dier of 'n mens nie' is part of one sentence, so AWS takes no comma there.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'op een slag' is the idiomatic Afrikaans expression; 'in een keer' is a Dutch-style calque.
toegepas.fout: 'in een keer' is a Dutch-style calque.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'op een slag' is the fixed Afrikaans expression for 'at one go' and carries the same meaning.

laat_vaar.voor: hou die trein ook op een pad
laat_vaar.na: hou die trein ook op koers
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'op een pad' is vague; 'op koers' is the natural idiom for keeping something on its course.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'op een pad' is plain and clear for Grade 4, while 'op koers' is more abstract and shifts the sense from staying on one line to keeping a direction.
